lastCompletedStory.title: Classify remote prune by end-state in runPostMerge

nextStoryContext: US-001 added checkAndPruneRemoteBranch helper (ls-remote pre-check -> end-state classification). The US-002 story (local branch prune: classify by end-state too, i.e. check if branch still exists after -d) follows the exact same pattern. The SpawnFn signature is unchanged; the happySpawn fake in post-merge.test.ts now fully models ls-remote. Step 5 in runPostMerge was replaced by a single call to the helper.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-001 is pure git CLI + TypeScript; no NPM library was added or modified.
